question: From the film recap, the teenagers are shown arriving on the Fiji island (timestamp ~150s), and later in the video, Dr. Hale appears in Los Angeles (timestamp ~680s). The narrative progresses forward in time. Based on the dates shown on screen in the video and their chronological relationship, calculate: (a) the total number of days that pass between these two dates, and (b) express this time span in complete weeks and any remaining days. Additionally, explain whether the calculation would be impacted if the period included a leap year (with February 29th), and if so, indicate how many days would need to be added.
answer: (a) 81 days total; (b) 11 weeks and 4 days; Leap year does not affect calculation since February is not included in the date range.
